records.title: Public Health Principles and Practice
records.header: SPH 380 Public Health Principles and Practice (5)
records.text: SPH 380 Public Health Principles and Practice (5) Provides a broad overview of public health and introduces foundational principles, theories, and frameworks of public health and key issues faced today. Course overlaps with: TBIOMD 201. Offered: AWSp.
records.schedulingNote: Catalog prerequisites/offering patterns are not current registration permission or guaranteed future offerings.

records.title: Science and Public Health
records.text: SPH 381 Science and Public Health (5) Provide an overview and introduction to the ways different scientific disciplines are used to address public health goals. Course overlaps with: TBIOMD 201. Prerequisite: minimum grade of 1.7 in SPH 380; either BIOL 118, BIOL 180, CHEM 120, CHEM 142, CHEM 145, or both MICROM 301 and MICROM 302. Offered: AWSp.
